lia-incident-bot: [INCIDENT] rwinf-embeddings-ingest — Severity: SEV2
lia-incident-bot: Pager triggered 2026-03-14T21:42:11Z. Intermittent worker pool errors caused ~12% of active customers to see retries/5xx during a ~47m window. Auto-retries recovered most flows but a handful of ingestions failed. Opening PIR thread to schedule review, capture customer impact, and assign remediation owners.

Jordan (Support): FYI 7 customer tickets opened, 2 escalations (high-priority). Customers reported delayed indexing and some missing vectors. I'll need the timeline and a message we can send post-PIR.

Sam (PM): Thanks. We should include a short customer-impact summary in the invite. I can draft a pre-read; want the suspected cause and mitigation timeline by then.

Maya (Eng Oncall): I can assemble the timeline and raw logs. Still running a hotpatch so can't facilitate.

Ethan (SRE): I can facilitate if needed, but Thur morning I'm out. Prefer Tue/Wed.

Priya (Infra): I'll export infra diffs, NV driver logs, and the autoscaler event timeline. OOO Tue afternoon but can upload before then.

Kelsey (Eng): I'll prepare a 5-slide perf deck with KV cache hit/miss and tail-latency graphs.

Noor (Security): Noting we should redact customer PII in the pre-read. Happy to do a quick pass.

lia-incident-bot: Proposed PIR slots (react with :one:/:two: or suggest). Add :hand: to volunteer to facilitate.
```
1) Tue 2026-03-16 16:00-17:00 UTC — NA/EU overlap.
2) Wed 2026-03-17 09:00-10:00 UTC — NA morning, EU late morning.
3) Thu 2026-03-18 15:00-16:00 UTC — fallback.
```

Jordan (Support): :one: for Pat (support lead) — he'll attend then.

Sam (PM): :two: preferred but I can do :one: if that ends up being majority.

Maya (Eng Oncall): :two: — prefer not Thu.

Ethan (SRE): :one: + :hand: — I'll facilitate Tue if that's the pick. Can we also pick a backup facilitator in case my calendar conflicts?

Priya (Infra): :one: — will upload diffs to the doc before Tue.

Kelsey (Eng): :one: — will add perf deck link.

Luis (ENG): :one: — I'll help with ingestion worker metrics.

Devon (Platform): :two: or :three: due to infra deploy window on Tue afternoon.

lia-incident-bot: Current tally: slot 1 has (Jordan/Pat, Ethan, Priya, Kelsey, Luis), slot 2 has (Sam, Maya, Devon). Suggest locking slot 1.

Sam (PM): Lock slot 1 then. I'll make the calendar invite and add pre-read links. Pre-read owners: timeline (Maya), infra diffs (Priya), perf slides (Kelsey), customer ticket set (Jordan), suspected RCA sketch (Ethan). I'll consolidate into one doc.

Ethan (SRE): I'll put a short suspected root-cause note in the doc — likely autoscaler thrash + cache-priming gap causing timeouts under a spike pattern.

Jordan (Support): I'll paste ticket IDs and redact customer names per Noor's request. Pat will own post-PIR customer comms if we confirm scope.

Noor (Security): Thanks — please mark any transcript sections with PII and I'll clean.

Maya (Eng Oncall): Suggest agenda: 1) timeline & customer impact (10m), 2) infra & autoscaler events (10m), 3) perf traces & KV cache analysis (10m), 4) RCA discussion (15m), 5) action items + owners (15m). Any objections?

Kelsey (Eng): Agenda looks good. Also add a short "what prevented faster recovery" slot — we had retries but some clients failed.

Ethan (SRE): Good call. Add a runbook gap review item.

Sam (PM): I'll include those two items. Also request that everyone paste short bullets in the doc by EOD Mon so I can assemble the pre-read.

Priya (Infra): Will upload diffs and autoscaler logs by EOD Mon.

Luis (ENG): I'll upload the ingestion metrics and small script outputs.

Jordan (Support): Tickets and escalation notes uploaded. Pat will RSVP on the calendar once invite lands.

Ethan (SRE): Backup facilitator: if I'm pulled into an incident, can @Kelsey or @Devon step in? Kelsey can run the perf bits but Devon can handle scheduling. Thoughts?

Kelsey (Eng): I can step in as backup facilitator for the meeting, happy to.

Devon (Platform): I can cover facilitation if needed and will also ensure calendar invite has Zoom link & recording enabled.

lia-incident-bot: Calendar invite created by Sam (invite sent to list). Meeting locked: Tue 2026-03-16 16:00-17:00 UTC. Facilitator: Ethan (primary), Kelsey (backup), Devon (backup2). Pre-read due: Mon EOD.

Sam (PM): Shared doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/pir/rwinf-embeddings-2026-03-14 (please check permissions).

Jordan (Support): Pat (support lead) confirmed :thumbsup:.

Noor (Security): I'll review pre-read for PII once Sam posts consolidated draft.

Maya (Eng Oncall): Noted — will add timeline + key log snippets.

Ethan (SRE): I'll capture action item template during the meeting and own follow-up tracking for 2 weeks. Can we also add a "rollback/fallback" review to see if we could have reduced customer impact?

Sam (PM): Added rollback/fallback to agenda.

Jordan (Support): One ask from customers: include a note about prevention plan and ETA to avoid recurrence. We'll want something concrete to share.

Ethan (SRE): Action item preview: 1) Increase autoscaler cooldown (owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-23), 2) Add prefix/KV prewarm for ingestion spike (owner: Kelsey, due: 2026-03-30), 3) Improve retry visibility for support (owner: Jordan, due: 2026-03-20). Will formalize during PIR.

Priya (Infra): Noted on cooldown change, will prototype config change in staging first.

Sam (PM): Thanks all. If anyone else needs to join (legal / compliance) speak up now. Otherwise we'll proceed with this attendee list.

Noor (Security): I'll join if there's any customer data exposure to review. Otherwise I can review asynchronously.

lia-incident-bot: Thread locked for scheduling. Please RSVP on the calendar and add your pre-read bullets to the doc by EOD Mon.

Jordan (Support): Will do.

Kelsey (Eng): Uploading slides now.

Devon (Platform): I added recording settings and a brief facilitation checklist to the doc.

Ethan (SRE): Thanks team. See you Tue 16:00 UTC.
